status: intake-decision-policy; isolated enforcement tests; production enforcement not yet wired
purpose: Preserve evidentiary content and protect private third persons

author_dušan_dvořák.name: full where acting as author or party; name alone never triggers anonymization
author_dušan_dvořák.other_personal_identifiers: redact unless independently established lawful necessity

official_public_capacity.name: full when relevant to official act and lawful

private_third_person.name: initials only when not identifying in context; otherwise neutral label

always_review: signatures and hidden identifying PDF layers
review_requirements: classify each person in context, never infer from title alone
retain original unchanged outside public repository
use exact original only after document-specific privacy review confirms no prohibited identifiers
when redaction is needed remove underlying bytes and metadata, not visual overlays
check scanned pages visually and verify extracted and decoded content
do not change official reference numbers or substantive evidence unless required to protect a private person
existing explicit exclusions and holds remain effective
bind final public SHA-256 to actual reviewed bytes
no publication authorization granted by this policy alone
no transformation solely because the exempt author's name occurs
the presence of the exempt author never waives third-person identification checks
unchanged exact bytes may be retained after review; no blanket document-level exemption
public identifiers in official capacity are not a blanket exemption for private contact or sensitive details
